verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is indirect. ADK ships SDKs in statically typed languages (TypeScript, Go, Java, Kotlin), so agent code can be type-checked at compile time, and the Task API mentions 'single-turn controlled output', which hints at structured outputs. Nothing documents schema validation of tool or agent definitions, or build-time error detection aimed at coding agents. Missing for 10: documented typed tool/input/output schemas, schema validation of agent configs and outputs, build-time type checking or linting workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
